# The online appendix {#home .unnumbered}

This online appendix accompanies *Social Security Design and Its Political Support* by Rasmus K. S. Berg and
Martín Gonzalez-Eiras. It extends the paper's three quantitative sections, on Argentina's pension reform, on the
rich economies with the pension design given and on the endogenous design. It shows the results across the
intertemporal and the Frisch elasticity, the UK compared with the U.S., the alternative calibration of the taste for
leisure, a second cost of redistribution, and the paths behind the paper's readings in a single year. Every number
is built by the paper's own pipeline from the model's results; none is typed.

:::

**Reading the figures.** An interactive figure opens on the paper's specification, and its legend marks the paper's
values. Point at a bar, a marker or a point to read its value. The controls above a figure change what it shows, and the address in the browser keeps the selection, so
a link opens the same view. Under every exhibit, *Data* downloads the numbers it shows and *Source* names the
results files it reads, the code that builds it and the command that rebuilds it. A blue label marks an exhibit
that is also in the paper, with its number there.
